`short-mp3.b64` is a complete MP3 from Edge Jenny reading the public test phrase
"Audio test." (11,808 bytes, 1.968 seconds). It is used only to test file parsing,
stream saving, uploads and cache behavior without a network connection. It is
never used as narration or as a Vietnamese fallback. Voice selection tests mock
the provider and assert which Vietnamese voice was requested; they do not assert
that the fixture itself is Vietnamese speech.
